purpose: Graphics quality scaling of tape/TV buffers with unfiltered full-resolution screen UI

notes: No-present batch includes CPU submission plus GPU completion and amortized single image readback.
Batch percentiles describe 30-frame averages, not individual GPU frame latency.
Normal fallback may retain OS display pacing despite disabled VSync and frame limit.
Effect clocks advance by1/60 per force_draw; automatic glitches are disabled.
Quality ladder uses each preset's real world resolution, antialiasing and lighting; no forced 480-line workload.

limitations: Measured on M3 Max only; not validation of low-powered hardware.
Two opposite-order rounds, three 30-frame no-present batches per case per round.
Includes CPU submission, GPU completion and amortized single readback; not gameplay FPS or pure GPU time.
Before comparison holds Low scene resolution, lighting, AA and current UI routing constant; restores previous 720x480 signal and native processed output.
